definitions.explanation: An academic course that students may choose to take but is not required for graduation.

examples.japanese: {選択科目|せんたくかもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
{選択科目|せんたくかもく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: You can take elective courses that interest you.

examples.japanese: {選択科目|せんたくかもく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{二単位|にたんい}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{履修|りしゅう}→履修：04861_rishuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと。
examples.english: You must take at least two credits from the elective courses.

notes:
{選択科目|せんたくかもく} refers to courses that students can choose based on their interests. Unlike required courses, these are optional but may still be needed to complete credit requirements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選択科目|せんたくかもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (to choose electives)
- {選択科目|せんたくかもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履修|りしゅう}→履修：04861_rishuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to enroll in an elective)
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧{選択科目|せんたくかもく} (free elective)
